eikonal.note: 26-neighbour shortest paths overestimate oblique travel times; max error is a geometry bound (~8% at directions like (2,1,0))

dipole.note: volume form -sum(grad Vm) dV and surface form -sum(Vm n dA) agree up to the finite-difference treatment of the wall voxels

lead_field.note: Dower vectors come from measurements on a torso model; the infinite medium ignores the torso boundary and lungs, so agreement is expected only to tens of degrees

ecgsyn.note: ECGSYN is a phenomenological single-lead model (5 Gaussians on a limit cycle); BeatNet beats come from activation physics, so only the gross timing and shape should match

physiology.textbook: normal QRS 70-110 ms (vector-onset/offset definition reads shorter than manual calipers); BBB >= 120 ms; PVC 120-200 ms; axis -30..+90 deg; T/R ~0.1-0.4; P/R ~0.05-0.2; full compensatory pause ratio 1.0 after PVC, < 1 after APB
